name: Ooe Otoha
source: [url=/c17475]Kagura's[/url] younger twin sister. Otoha has a very kind personality. Because of her weak body, she often spends time at the school infirmary. She is very skilled at cooking, and started cooking because she felt sorry for her sister having to look after her all the time.
